strings.string:
This watch face shows only the current time. It does not stop the watch's sensors or radios on its own.
Before Shabbat: 1. Switch to this watch face. 2. Settings > System > Power Manager > Battery Saver: enable Disconnect Phone, Disable Activity Tracking, Disable Wrist HR, Disable Bluetooth, Disable Wi-Fi. Turn Battery Saver ON. 3. Settings > Connectivity > Airplane Mode: ON. 4. Enable Do Not Disturb.
After Havdalah, reverse these steps and switch back to your normal watch face.
This app is a tool, not a Halachic ruling. Consult your Rav.
